cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Nobody received my meeting email. This office has stopped communicating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. And nobody noticed. Our entire communication system depends on my memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it. Go and have your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're covering communications while I'm absent. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich.

comparison: Communication workflow versus physical entry signs.
